profile.name: ANANDA DEVELOPMENT PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company's main business is the development of condominium projects located near railway mass transit stations in Bangkok and its peripheral areas. The Company also develops landed housing. In addition, the Company also operates other businesses through its subsidiaries, including an agent in selling its condominium units, management services for condominiums and landed housing projects
